meta.spread_signal_policy: Only tracked-sample games with at least a five-point model-versus-market disagreement and a consensus from three or more books are eligible.
meta.totals_signal_policy: Withheld until totals validation clears its independent promotion gate.
meta.four_factor_method: Neutral preseason Four Factor baselines blend toward chronological current-season offense and defense observations.
meta.home_court_method: Program-specific five-season regularized conference-game estimates replace the model's national campus coefficient; neutral-site games receive zero.
meta.prediction_interval_policy: 80% ranges use the fitted training residual distributions for margin and total. They communicate model uncertainty and are not betting thresholds.
